title: The Immersed Discontinuous Galerkin Method for Elliptic Interface Problems
summary: This paper is devoted to construction and convergence analysis of the linear explicit immersed finite element (IFE) function. For the interface elements, the proposed IFE functions precisely satisfy the interface conditions on the actual interface. The IFE functions are constructed in an explicit form and can be obtained directly without solving any auxiliary problems or local linear systems.
